basics.name: Emad Mahmodi
basics.label: Software Engineer · Data Scientist · Security & Reverse-Engineering Researcher
basics.summary: Software engineer and applied-ML researcher with 10+ years spanning software engineering, data science, high-performance computing, and security. Three peer-reviewed machine-learning publications (anomaly detection, recommender systems; Google Scholar h-index 3). Strength in turning hard, structured data — binaries, graphs, network traffic — into working ML and systems: from a drift-aware anomaly-detection ensemble to GPU-accelerated graph analytics and LLM/RAG pipelines for binary analysis, backed by deep automotive reverse-engineering expertise.

interests.name: Machine Learning & Data Science: anomaly detection, concept drift, cross-domain generalization, and recommender systems.
Algorithms & High-Performance Computing: parallel and GPU (CUDA/OpenMP) algorithms on irregular, power-law data.
AI for Cybersecurity: leveraging LLMs and RAG for automated binary analysis and firmware documentation.
Binary Reverse Engineering: analysis of automotive ECUs (ISA reconstruction, Seed/Key bypass, checksum extraction).

courses: Thesis: Adaptive rule-based phishing detection against URL obfuscation (Grade: 18/20)
Supervisors: Dr. Hadi Sadoghi Yazdi, Dr. Abbas Ghaemi Bafghi
Final project: Integrated online sales management system (Grade: 20/20)

work.name: Negar-Khodro
work.position: Senior Software Developer & Lead Reverse Engineer
work.summary: Architected ECUProg v2: a comprehensive automotive programming platform in C++17 and Qt 6. Optimized memory footprint by 49% and reduced JTAG overhead by 62%.
highlights: Firmware Reconstruction: led reverse-engineering efforts for TriCore (Infineon) and PowerPC (VLE) architectures; reconstructed logic for diagnostic services (UDS/KWP2000).
Tuning & Remapping: designed 'Negaremap', a native Persian remapping platform with automated table identification and checksum-correction algorithms.
AI Automation: prototyped an LLM/RAG pipeline and authored custom Ghidra/IDA Pro plugins to accelerate binary analysis of automotive firmware.

work.name: Shomal University, Amol
work.position: Lecturer & M.Sc. Thesis Advisor — Computer Engineering
work.summary: Part-time academic role in the Department of Computer Engineering; applied machine-learning research and teaching.
highlights: Taught the graduate course 'Principles of Data Mining' (2nd semester, 2019–2020).

Advised two M.Sc. theses on recommender systems — group recommendation via leader/member influence, and collaborative filtering with dimensionality reduction & semantic methods; both students co-authored publications with me.

work.name: NIUniverse
highlights: Vulnerability Research: audited diagnostic-tool protection layers, bypassing anti-debugging and V-table obfuscation for integrity analysis.
System Programming: developed high-speed communication drivers for PC-to-hardware interfacing.

work.name: Ferdowsi University of Mashhad — DCSL & Pattern Recognition Lab
work.summary: Research and development in the Data & Communication Security Lab (DCSL) and Pattern Recognition Lab (PRL).
highlights: Built data-mining, anomaly-detection, and recommender-system pipelines (C++, Python, SQL) underpinning the ESWA (2020) and IJE (2020) publications.

projects.name: GPU-Accelerated Graph Analytics (Empirical Study)
projects.description: Reproducible study of GPU acceleration for BFS, PageRank, WCC, and Louvain on power-law security graphs — C++17, OpenMP, CUDA.
highlights: Tiered baseline-to-CUDA methodology with a correctness oracle; measured OpenMP thread-scaling (up to 6x) on real hardware.

projects.name: Cross-Domain IDS Generalization (PyTorch)
projects.description: PyTorch reimplementation of my drift-aware ensemble, evaluated under real distribution shift on NSL-KDD.
highlights: Quantified a 21-point in-domain to cross-domain generalization gap (F1 0.97 to 0.76) via external validation.

projects.name: Context-Augmented RAG for Binary Analysis
projects.description: Lightweight retrieval-augmented pipeline for binary function-name recovery; an independent take on the ReCopilot idea, with no model training.
highlights: Tool-independent PLT→GOT→symbol call-context extraction; pluggable LLM backends (mock/OpenAI/Ollama) with an honest method comparison.

projects.name: Bajaj MSE2 ECU Reverse Engineering & Security Audit
projects.description: Extracted firmware via JTAG/Bootloader and performed line-by-line disassembly using IDA Pro.
highlights: Reconstructed the Fault Management logic (sub_2B2C) and DTC generation thresholds.
Identified vulnerabilities in the Seed/Key security handshake (Service 0x27) by mapping XOR/bit-shift operations.

projects.name: PISAD ECU Full Simulator (PowerPC)
projects.description: Created a virtual environment to execute and debug PPC-based ECU dumps without physical hardware.
highlights: Implemented register monitoring and real-time state analysis for security-bypass verification.

projects.name: Locomotive GT26 Control System
projects.description: Designed a real-time state machine in C++ to manage engine parameters and safety interlocks.
highlights: Developed a high-speed data-acquisition system using FPGA-to-PC shared-memory communication.
